mapper.select: SELECT count(1) AS cnt FROM ${msg_table} WHERE MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '00' AND SEND_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(SEND_EXPECTED_DT || SEND_EXPECTED_TIME , 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') <= SYSTIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE ${msg_table} SET MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '01' WHERE MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '00' AND SEND_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(SEND_EXPECTED_DT || SEND_EXPECTED_TIME , 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') < SYSTIMESTAMP AND ROWNUM <= 500
mapper.select: SELECT MESSAGE_MST_NO AS MSGID, 'PH' AS MSGTYPE, CASE WHEN SEND_TYPE_CD = 'M1' THEN 'S' WHEN SEND_TYPE_CD = 'M2' THEN 'L' ELSE 'L' END AS MSGKIND, MESSAGE_CONTENT AS MSG, MESSAGE_CONTENT AS MSGSMS, RECEIVER_PHONE_NO AS PHN, SENDER_PHONE_NO AS SENDER, BROF_CD AS PINVOICE, MESSAGE_TITLE AS MSGTITLE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REGDT, SEND_EXPECTED_DT || SEND_EXPECTED_TIME AS RESERVEDT FROM ${msg_table} WHERE SEND_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}' AND MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '01'
mapper.update: update ${msg_table} set MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '02' where MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '01' and SEND_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}'
update ${msg_table} set MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '00' where MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '01' and SEND_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}'
